m14.text: Skrikkle, a goblin tired of skrill slime, threw it at Groggle and stormed out of the warren to hunt grubs.
He plotted to become king and kill Grooble with his digging stick, and was so absorbed in dueling an imaginary Grooble that he failed to notice an approaching giant foot.
The giant foot crushed him, and with it faded the echoes and vain hopes born of madness.
